---
title: MCP demo
---

You can use Quarto 2's built-in [MCP](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Model_Context_Protocol) to let your LLM agent edit documents collaboratively. To use it, you'll need to install Quarto 2's [prerelease binary](https://github.com/quarto-dev/q2/#installing). For the time being, you'll also need `node` in your system.

To register it with an MCP client, add an entry that launches q2 mcp (run q2 mcp --print-config to print this snippet):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "quarto-hub": {
      "command": "q2",
      "args": ["mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

From there, tell your agent to connect to quarto-hub and give it the index id of the project you want it to open (this information is available on the "Project" accordion tab). It'll be able to list files, read them, and edit them in the same session you're in.
